source_state: uncommitted bounded inference implementation with selected convolution tensor/host facts, corrected transpose cropping and stable low-precision Winograd realization

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

ownership: neutral tensor contracts describe convolution geometry; reusable native predicates choose and price the same realization without family branches
bound_derivation: Two possible F32-bounded operand casts and two possible contiguous operand copies, plus output storage; no donation or early release assumed.
Depthwise and implicit kernels allocate no unfolded matrix. Their geometry-selected branch receives no im2col charge.

Explicit ungrouped convolution allocates the unfolded matrix and any direct Steel split-K accumulator. A direct Steel GEMM retains split-K for one-row outputs, independently of ordinary matmul GEMV routing.
Explicit grouped convolution allocates one grouped unfolded matrix and one transposed weight buffer; it calls regular grouped GEMM without split-K.

Winograd allocates padded input, a fill scalar, transformed weights [64,C,O], transformed inputs [64,tiles,C], transformed outputs [64,tiles,O], and the result. Reduced-precision operands use F32 computation plus a final output conversion, also charged.
Cropping a transposed result retains its entire uncropped allocation, which the output storage bound preserves.
Every native tensor capacity includes page rounding and bounded oversized allocator-cache reuse. Existing inputs are separate baseline residency.

host_domain.derivation: Convolution payloads, casts, compaction, unfolding, Winograd transforms and the scalar fill all use the same shared Metal tensor allocator. There is no disjoint host payload staging. Native command/shape metadata, JIT storage and driver bookkeeping are outside the managed payload domain.
host_domain.scope: Only recognized valid convolution descriptors receive this derived fact. A missing host fact in another operation keeps the complete trace unknown.

transposed_crop.cause: negative native padding cropped the undilated input, multiplying the removed output positions by the stride
transposed_crop.fix: compute without padding and crop the expanded result only for the affected geometry; execution and pricing share a cold predicate

winograd_precision.fix: matching F16 or BF16 operands use F32 convolution in Metal builds, then restore their original output dtype; other pairs preserve native promotion
winograd_precision.cost: additional F32 temporaries and possible result-conversion storage are explicit in the bound

measurement.method: serial Metal execution; evaluate and retain input/weight tensors, synchronize, capture active baseline and reset peak, execute/evaluate output, synchronize, compare peak-minus-baseline with tensor bound; numerical export occurs afterwards; allocator cache remains populated
measurement.oracle: independent scalar cross-correlation or transposed scatter equation over original exact binary-fraction inputs; full comparison for outputs up to 65536 elements, otherwise 257 spread positions; every output is checked for finite values and dtype promotion
